# Manual Editor dependencies

markdown-it 15.0.3: browser UMD bundle from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/markdown-it@15.0.3/dist/browser/markdown-it.umd.min.js ; upstream project https://github.com/markdown-it/markdown-it . Its MIT license is retained in markdown-it/LICENSE. Raw HTML parsing is disabled, and the application bridge scheme is rejected as a Markdown link target.

dkjson 2.11 is stored under ../../Lib/dkjson.lua, downloaded from https://dkolf.de/dkjson-lua/dkjson-2.11.lua . Its upstream license is included in that file.

These are application-owned vendored files. No files under Scripts/Plugins were changed.
